oral_examination.oral_examination: *24 Residual roots, carious, loose (-), probing (-), percussion (-). Nothing special.

treatment_plan.notes: Instruct patients to avoid eating foods that are too cold/hot/hard/sticky. If you have looseness and discomfort, you should follow up in time and make an appointment by phone before coming.

source_handle: *24 Local disinfection with povidone-iodine and local infiltration anesthesia with bistriol. After the anesthesia takes effect, the gums are separated, the teeth are loosened, and the tooth extraction forceps are removed. Routinely scratch the tooth extraction wound and apply pressure to stop bleeding.
